faq.lead: Quick answers about levels, voice, games, and events.
faq.how1: Pick a category with the tabs below.
faq.how2: If there are multiple questions, pick one with the switcher below and read the answer.
faq.elsewhereBody: Our bot commands: Wiki. Perks for all roles: Perks.
faq.q1.title: How can I earn EXP points?
faq.q1.body: Every chat message and time spent in voice channels raises your EXP (voice EXP is doubled). On PERKS you can see what unlocks at each level, while leaderboards are in COMMUNITY.
faq.q2.title: How can I join the minigames?
faq.q2.body: Every 15 minutes, from 8:00 AM to 11:59 PM, you can play small chat games sent by our bot. They are optional — if you want to have fun with others, compete, and earn extra EXP, this is for you!
faq.q3.title: Can we listen to music together?
faq.q3.body: Absolutely! In voice rooms you can listen or share what you like, respecting volume and the rules (no earrape, nothing disruptive), using our official bots. To discover every command, check the WIKI.
faq.q4.title: Which games are available?
faq.q4.body: There are many channels like Pokétwo, Counting, Ship, plus chat minigames with the bot. Not every game is for every taste — if one is not for you, just skip it.
faq.q5.title: How do seasonal events work?
faq.q5.body: While you are on the server you can join full SEASONS lasting about 3 months. Each period has a main theme with many events, contests, and challenges designed to keep you hooked!
faq.q6.title: How can I improve my chances of winning events?
faq.q6.body: Follow the event instructions carefully — they list every way to get ahead. Being active in voice and text helps a lot. For bonuses, voting and boosting usually unlock perks listed under VOTE and PERKS. There is no single shortcut: rewards go to people who join with consistency and enthusiasm!
faq.q7.title: What does "paid staff" mean?
faq.q7.body: Every month the best staff member is rewarded with one month of Nitro Boost. Partner Managers are rewarded with Nitro Boost and cash prizes based on their performance.
faq.q8.title: Can I become a staff member?
faq.q8.body: Of course! We are always looking for new people to join our team. After reading the rules carefully, submit your application through the form on this site. Seriousness and consistency matter! If you have experience, say so. After applying, do not ping staff or open tickets to ask about the outcome.

legal.privacy.s1.title: Introduction
legal.privacy.s1.body:
This Privacy Policy describes how Vinili & Caffè collects, uses, and protects personal data related to:

  • the website and dashboard;
  • Discord bots (including Vinili and related services such as Caffè);
  • the official Discord server of the Vinili & Caffè community;
  • community services also on third-party Discord servers where the bot has been invited, within the limits of the enabled features.

Processing complies with the GDPR, applicable Italian law, and the policies of third-party services we use (in particular Discord).
legal.privacy.s1b.title: Data controller
legal.privacy.s1b.body:
The data controller is Lorenzo Antonio Corvaglia, operator of the Vinili & Caffè project, reachable at supporto@viniliecaffe.it and through the official community Discord server.

Third-party Discord servers: when the bot runs on a non-official server, that server’s administrator remains responsible for configuration choices and typical host-community processing; we process the data needed to operate the bot features enabled on that server.
legal.privacy.s2.title: Data we collect
legal.privacy.s2.body:
Discord login on the site (OAuth)

OAuth is the “Sign in with Discord” system: Discord confirms who you are without giving us your password.

  • Discord ID, username, display name, and avatar (identify permission: who you are).
  • List of Discord servers where you have management powers, only if you use the dashboard (guilds permission).
  • In some dashboard flows, also the applications.commands.permissions.update permission to manage the bot’s command permissions on the server.
  • Access tokens and session data needed to keep you logged in on the site.

Data processed on the website

  • Live support tickets (subject, category, messages, images, reactions, status, and closure).
  • Suggestions, reviews, bot feedback, applications, appeals, and other forms you submit voluntarily.
  • In-app notifications and related preferences; optional browser push notifications (push subscription, Notification permission, technical endpoint) if you enable them.
  • Confessionale content (texts/attachments handled by authorized staff, even when shown anonymously to users).
  • Operational data in restricted areas (dashboard/staff) for authorized users, including moderation tools and operational preview.
  • Donation/premium credit data when you use those features (status, technical references; payments are handled by the payment provider).

Data processed by bots and the Discord community

  • Messages, commands, reactions, and metadata for levels/XP, Discord tickets, moderation, minigames, events, quotes/reposts/clips, and leaderboards.
  • Partnership data, voice preferences (TTS/clips/transcriptions), and vote data from external platforms.
  • Live-integration metadata (e.g. Twitch / Kick) when related alerts or tools are enabled.

Voice transcriptions and automated tools

  • Transcriptions: audio may be sent to a speech-to-text service (e.g. Whisper) solely to obtain text. We do not use generative AI chatbots.
  • Markov: a simple statistical model from public messages (not an LLM and it does not decide sanctions).

Technical data, cookies, and measurement

  • OAuth tokens/cache, language preference, cookie-banner acknowledgement, push keys, and other technical keys in localStorage/sessionStorage.
  • Technical logs, IP addresses, and diagnostics within the limits needed for security and reliability.
  • Google Analytics (ID G-KPF6425N60) to measure audience and stability, loaded on all site pages.
legal.privacy.s3.title: How we use data
legal.privacy.s3.body:
We use your personal data to:

  • Authenticate and manage access to the site, dashboard, and authorized staff areas.
  • Provide community and bot features (profile, levels, music, TTS/voice, partnership, Discord tickets and live site tickets, moderation, events, voting, live alerts).
  • Handle suggestions, reviews, bot feedback, applications, confessionale, donations/credits, and support requests.
  • Send in-app notifications and, if you enable them, browser push notifications.
  • Measure site usage (Google Analytics on all pages) to understand traffic and stability.
  • Configure the bot on Discord servers managed by authorized administrators.
  • Prevent fraud, abuse, unauthorized automation, and malicious behavior.
  • Protect the site, bots, infrastructure, and community.
  • Meet legal obligations and handle support, moderation, or GDPR requests.
  • Improve the stability, security, and quality of our services.
legal.privacy.s4.title: Legal basis (GDPR)
legal.privacy.s4.body:
Data processing is based on:

  • Performance of the service for login, account management, and features you request (tickets, profile, bots, etc.).
  • Legitimate interest for community protection, abuse prevention, security, moderation, and technical site measurement (analytics).
  • Legal obligation when required to comply with requests or regulatory duties.
  • Consent where required, for example for browser push notifications or other optional features that require it.
legal.privacy.s5.title: Data sharing
legal.privacy.s5.body:
Your data is not sold. It may be shared only with parties strictly needed for the service, such as:

  • Discord Inc., for OAuth, server hosting, and platform APIs.
  • Hosting, database, and infrastructure providers that keep the site and bots online.
  • Google (Google Analytics) for measuring traffic on pages where the script is active.
  • Voting/listing platforms (e.g. top.gg, Discadia) when you use or receive voting features.
  • Payment providers (e.g. PayPal) when you make a donation or related payment.
  • Twitch / Kick and related services, only for enabled live/alert features.
  • Technical voice transcription (speech-to-text) providers, only if you use clip/transcription.
  • Authorized staff, for tickets, confessionale, suggestions, moderation, and operational tools.
  • Administrators of the Discord server you are in, for data needed to operate that server.
  • Competent authorities, if required by law or to protect the security of the service.

We do not share data with advertisers for personalized advertising. We do not train third-party generative AI models on your content.
legal.privacy.s6.title: Cookies
legal.privacy.s6.body:
We use cookies and similar technologies (including localStorage, sessionStorage, and, when enabled, a service worker for push) mainly to:

  • Maintain the Discord login session (up to 90 days or until logout).
  • Remember language, UI preferences, push status, and cookie-banner acknowledgement.
  • Protect the site with abuse controls and technical tokens.
  • Measure audience on pages where Google Analytics is active.
  • Make pages and restricted areas work correctly.

For the detailed list, see the Cookie Policy.
legal.privacy.s7.title: Data security
legal.privacy.s7.body:
We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect processed data, including:

  • HTTPS/TLS connections and session protection.
  • OAuth checks (anti-CSRF state) and checks against unauthorized access.
  • Access limits to data for authorized staff only.
  • Logging, monitoring, and abuse-mitigation tools where needed.
  • Backups and infrastructure protections within the limits of the systems used.
legal.privacy.s8.title: Your rights (GDPR)
legal.privacy.s8.body:
Within the limits of the GDPR you can exercise the rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction or objection, portability, and — where processing is based on consent — withdrawal of consent at any time.

For data managed by the site and bots you can export it or request deletion from the Your data page (Discord sign-in). You can also reach us on the official Discord server or at supporto@viniliecaffe.it.

If you believe processing is not compliant, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the Italian Data Protection Authority (Garante).
legal.privacy.s9.title: Data retention
legal.privacy.s9.body:
We retain data for as long as needed for the purposes for which it is processed. The periods below are typical targets (unless a legal obligation or ongoing dispute applies): not every dataset has an automatic deletion timer; removal also happens via the “Your data” tools, requests, and maintenance operations where technically feasible.

  • Site session: up to 90 days, or until logout / token expiry.
  • Community profile / points / progress: while you remain a member or use the services; after leaving or a deletion request, normally up to 12 months for technical closure and abuse prevention, unless anonymized earlier.
  • Web tickets and attachments: normally up to 24 months after closure, then deletion or anonymization.
  • Suggestions, reviews, feedback, applications: normally up to 36 months, or earlier on request/moderation.
  • Confessionale: normally up to 24 months, accessible to authorized staff; deletable earlier on request or moderation.
  • Moderation logs (warn/timeout/ban) and partnership: normally up to 36 months for security and disputes.
  • Push subscriptions: until permission is revoked, technical logout, or the subscription is deleted.
  • Voice transcriptions: audio processed transiently; text retained only if the feature requires it, normally up to 90 days unless moderation needs apply.
  • Markov corpus: statistical rotation/update; removal or reduction on request within technical limits.
  • Technical logs / IP: normally 30–90 days.
  • Google Analytics: according to Google Analytics retention settings.
  • Backups: typical cycles up to about 90 days, overlapping the periods above.
legal.privacy.s10.title: Minors
legal.privacy.s10.body:
The service is intended for users who meet Discord’s minimum age. In Italy, for digital processing based on consent, the typical threshold of 14 years also applies (unless otherwise required by law).

We do not knowingly collect data of minors below those thresholds. If we are informed of non-compliant collection, we may remove the data and limit access within reasonable technical and organizational limits.
legal.privacy.s11.title: International transfers
legal.privacy.s11.body:
Some services used by the project, such as Discord or other technical providers, may process data outside the European Economic Area.

When that happens, processing follows the safeguards offered by those providers and the limits set by the GDPR, including any standard contractual clauses or equivalent technical measures.
legal.privacy.s12.title: Policy changes
legal.privacy.s12.body:
We may update this Privacy Policy for legal, technical, or organizational changes. The last-updated date at the top indicates the current version.

By continuing to use the site or community services after changes are published, you acknowledge the updated version.
legal.privacy.s13.title: Contacts and complaints
legal.privacy.s13.body:
For privacy questions, GDPR requests, or reports you can contact us via Discord or email (supporto@viniliecaffe.it).

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Italian Data Protection Authority (www.garanteprivacy.it).
legal.terms.s1.title: Acceptance of terms
legal.terms.s1.body:
By using the Vinili & Caffè website ("Site"), the linked Discord bots ("Bots"), and associated or host Discord servers where the Bots are present ("Server"), you accept these Terms of Service. If you do not accept them, do not use the Site, Bots, Server, dashboard, or related features.

On third-party Discord servers where the Bot is installed, that server’s rules also apply: the host administrator is responsible for their own configuration choices.

Continued use after updates are published constitutes acceptance of the changes.
legal.terms.s2.title: Service description
legal.terms.s2.body:
Vinili & Caffè offers a Discord community and related services, including:

  • A Discord server for socializing, events, support, and community activities.
  • Public/multi-server bots (music, TTS/voice, levels, tickets, moderation, partnership, utilities) that can also be configured via a web dashboard.
  • Web pages for voting, profile, roles, wiki, applications, unban, notifications, suggestions, reviews, bot feedback, confessionale, donations/credits, and live support tickets.
  • Live integrations (e.g. Twitch/Kick) and related alerts, where enabled.
  • Restricted areas for staff and administrators (operational tools and configuration).
  • Integrations with Discord, voting platforms, payment providers, and other technical services needed.

We may modify, suspend, or remove parts of the service, site, bots, or Servers at any time.
legal.terms.s3.title: Access requirements
legal.terms.s3.body:
To use our services you must:

  • Meet at least Discord’s minimum age and, for site use in Italy, normally be at least 14 years old (or the age required by applicable law). If you are a minor, use must involve parental responsibility holders where required.
  • Use a valid, non-compromised Discord account.
  • Provide accurate data when submitting applications, requests, reviews, or other forms.
  • Keep your account secure and not share it to bypass checks or limits.
  • Follow these terms, the Privacy Policy, the Cookie Policy, and the server rules.
legal.terms.s4.title: Conduct rules
legal.terms.s4.body:
It is forbidden to

  • Violate applicable laws or Discord policies.
  • Post offensive, discriminatory, illegal, or harmful content.
  • Harass, threaten, intimidate, or impersonate other users or staff.
  • Use bots, scripts, multi-accounts, or abusive VPNs to fake votes, partnerships, levels, stats, or access.
  • Abuse the dashboard, APIs, vote webhooks, live site tickets, or migration/configuration systems.
  • Record or share others’ audio without a lawful basis, or use TTS/voice for harassment.
  • Attempt to compromise the site, bots, panels, or server security.
  • Spam, phish, run unauthorized advertising, or share third parties’ personal data.
  • Exploit bugs instead of reporting them to staff, or bypass bans/timeouts/limits.
legal.terms.s5.title: Voting system
legal.terms.s5.body:
• Votes must be genuine and compliant with the rules of external platforms (e.g. top.gg, Discadia).
  • Using bots, multi-accounts, abusive VPNs, or automated methods to obtain rewards is not allowed.
  • Points/progress/rewards may be corrected or voided in case of abuse.
  • Vote webhooks may process your Discord ID to grant rewards; third-party services may change without notice.
legal.terms.s6.title: Staff applications
legal.terms.s6.body:
• Applications are reviewed by staff at their discretion.
  • Submitting an application does not guarantee a reply, acceptance, or a staff role.
  • False information, spam, or abuse in forms may lead to rejection or sanctions.
  • Staff roles may be removed at any time for internal organization or violations.
  • Staff roles do not grant legal, economic, or ownership rights over the server or site.
legal.terms.s7.title: Intellectual property
legal.terms.s7.body:
Unless otherwise stated, the following content and assets remain the property of Vinili & Caffè or their respective owners:

  • Site: design, graphics, texts, code, logos, wiki, dashboard, and related materials.
  • Bots: code, configurations, branding, system messages, and operational documentation.
  • Official Discord server: community name and brand, icons, banners, custom emoji/stickers, layout, and graphic or textual materials created by staff for the server.

You may not copy, resell, distribute, republish, or reuse such content without written authorization. User content remains governed by the “User content” section; Discord and third-party providers remain owners of their respective platforms.
legal.terms.s8.title: User content
legal.terms.s8.body:
By posting messages, media, reviews, suggestions, feedback, tickets, applications, confessions, or other content on the Server or Site:

  • You retain ownership of your content, subject to law or Discord policies.
  • You grant us a limited license for service operation, moderation, technical publication and, where enabled, automated content generation (statistical Markov system) from public community messages.
  • You accept that tickets, confessionale, and support content on the site are visible to authorized staff to handle the request.
  • You warrant that you have the right to share what you post.
  • You remain responsible for the content you submit.
legal.terms.s8b.title: Donations and credits
legal.terms.s8b.body:
• Donations are voluntary and, as a rule, do not constitute a purchase of mandatory goods or services.
  • Payments are processed by third-party providers (e.g. PayPal): their terms and privacy policy also apply.
  • Any premium credits or virtual benefits have no cash value, are non-refundable except where required by law, and may be modified or revoked in case of abuse, error, or service changes.
  • We do not guarantee continuous availability of campaigns, rewards, or benefits linked to donations.
legal.terms.s9.title: Moderation and sanctions
legal.terms.s9.body: Staff may moderate or remove content, apply warn/timeout/kick/ban, block access obtained abusively, and decide internal disputes. Sanctions may be temporary or permanent based on severity, context, and repeat behavior.
legal.terms.s10.title: Limitation of liability
legal.terms.s10.body:
Vinili & Caffè is not responsible for

  • Loss of data, stats, progress, levels, preferences, or content.
  • Service interruptions, maintenance, downtime, or system changes.
  • Actions of other users, third-party content, or linked external services.

  • Indirect or consequential damages, or damages from improper use of the service.

The service is provided "as is", without warranties of continuous availability or specific results.
legal.terms.s11.title: Discord Terms of Service
legal.terms.s11.body: Our server is hosted on Discord. By using it you also accept Discord’s Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. If a feature depends on Discord, their rules and technical limits prevail. The duration of the site login session depends on the OAuth token issued by Discord.
legal.terms.s11b.title: Governing law
legal.terms.s11b.body:
These Terms are governed by Italian law, except for mandatory consumer-protection rules that apply to you.

For disputes, the Court of Lecce has jurisdiction, except where the law requires a mandatory venue (e.g. EU consumers, who can often also sue in the courts of their place of residence).
legal.terms.s12.title: Contacts
legal.terms.s12.body: For questions about the Terms of Service you can contact us via Discord or email (supporto@viniliecaffe.it).
legal.cookie.s1.title: What are cookies?
legal.cookie.s1.body:
Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a site. Similar technologies also include browser storage (localStorage/sessionStorage) for login, preferences, and security.

Scope: this Cookie Policy covers the website Vinili & Caffè (and related pages). The official Discord server and Bots remain governed by the Terms of Service, Privacy Policy, and community rules; Discord also applies its own technical policies on the platform.
legal.cookie.s2.title: Cookies we use
legal.cookie.s2.body:
Necessary for operation

We use strictly necessary technical cookies and local storage. Without them, login and restricted areas may not work.

Discord OAuth session — token and expiry in localStorage (up to 90 days / logout / token expiry). OAuth = “Sign in with Discord”.
Scope and profile cache — remember login permissions and minimal profile data to reduce Discord API calls.
Language preference — saves the site language.
Cookie banner preference — remembers banner acknowledgement (up to 180 days).
Push notifications (optional) — if you enable them: local permission/status keys and the browser service worker.
Technical UI state — local keys for in-app notifications, event access, or previews, without personalized advertising.

Measurement (analytics)

We use Google Analytics (ID G-KPF6425N60) to understand traffic and site stability. The script is present on all pages. We do not use advertising profiling, remarketing, or social-tracking cookies for ads (except Discord cookies during OAuth).
legal.cookie.s3.title: Cookie security
legal.cookie.s3.body:
Our cookies use advanced protections:

  • HTTPS/TLS — encrypted communications with API services.
  • Anti-CSRF OAuth state — state verification in login callbacks.
  • Session expiry — the local session ends after a maximum of 90 days, logout, or Discord token invalidation/expiry.
  • Minimized data — only technical data strictly needed for operation.
legal.cookie.s4.title: Cookie purposes
legal.cookie.s4.body:
We use cookies and local storage to:

  • Keep you authenticated on the site and dashboard.
  • Protect accounts and APIs from unauthorized access.
  • Prevent automated abuse.
  • Remember language, technical UI choices, and push-notification status (if enabled).
  • Measure traffic and page usage (Google Analytics).
  • Support voting and restricted areas.
legal.cookie.s5.title: Legal basis
legal.cookie.s5.body:
Cookies/storage that are strictly necessary for login, security, and site operation do not require explicit consent (GDPR / ePrivacy).

Measurement with Google Analytics is based on legitimate interest in understanding site use and improving stability and content. You can limit it via browser settings, anti-tracking extensions, or Google tools where available. We do not use advertising profiling cookies.

Push notifications require browser permission (consent).
legal.cookie.s6.title: How to manage cookies
legal.cookie.s6.body:
You can manage cookies and storage in your browser settings (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) or by clearing site data. Disabling essential items will prevent login. To remove the session, log out from the site.

For push: revoke the site’s notification permission in browser settings. For Analytics you can use browser cookie/tracker blockers.

Logout

Logout removes or invalidates local session data linked to login.
legal.cookie.s7.title: Third-party cookies
legal.cookie.s7.body:
During Discord OAuth authentication you may receive cookies from discord.com, managed by Discord Inc. under their Privacy Policy.

Google Analytics loads Google scripts/cookies (googletagmanager.com / google-analytics). Google’s policies also apply.

Vinili & Caffè does not have full control over these third parties’ cookies and processing.
